content: We need to determine number of carbonyl groups in the sample's compound. We have no SMILES or description. We need to retrieve data. Perhaps we can get IR spectra to see C=O stretch around 1700 cm-1. But we need number of carbonyl groups. Could also use carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~190-210 ppm). But we need the sample's compound; we don't have its identity. Maybe there is a default sample? The system may have a sample loaded. We can request carbon_nmr_spectra. That will give peaks. Then count carbonyl peaks. Let's try carbon_nmr_spectra.
